Definition
[hyperbolic pointed-limit space] Source: kleiner-lott 1. Definition 5\group Kleiner–Lott Long-Time Topology

Given $w >0$, let $\Lambda _w$ be the space of complete pointed finite-volume hyperbolic $3$-manifolds that arise as pointed limits of sequences $\{ (\M ^+_{t_i}, (x_i, t_i), t_i^{-1} g(t_i))\} _{i=1}^\infty $ with $\lim _{i \rightarrow \infty } t_i = \infty $ and the basepoint $(x_i,t_i)$ satisfying $(x_i,t_i) \in M^+(w, t_i) \subset \M ^+_{t_i}$ for all $i$.
